title: Workload capsule (capsule_bench_v0)
description: A compiler-input workload capsule: describes what to compile, the numeric golden policy, the expected Gemmini instruction coverage, the required oracle tiers, and the public/dev/hidden label. A capsule is an INPUT to the backend-under-test, never a kernel.

source_reference.description: bareMetalC path / torch module slice / ISA section / local spec id

dtype.description: Operand dtype. NOT a hardcoded list: validity is enforced by the extensible quant_formats registry (merlin.common.quant_formats + the MERLIN_QUANT_FORMATS overlay) and the build-time corpus_spec dtype table, so a new target's numeric format is a data contribution, not a schema edit.
Numeric-policy dtype — same open vocabulary as an operand dtype (validated by the quant_formats registry, not a hardcoded list).

instruction_classes.description: Required instruction classes, DERIVED per-target from the target's own ISA (e.g. gemmini RoCC classes, or a self-hosted ISA's semantic op patterns like MXUMatMul/TensorBaseOffset). Not a fixed enum: the class vocabulary is the target's, so validity is enforced by the per-target derivation (isa_taxonomy) + its coverage checker, not a hardcoded list here.

verilator.description: Availability of the cycle-accurate Verilator RTL-cert tier (L3). optional = graded when the sim is available but NOT a pass-gate; the mandatory numeric tier is whatever the capsule lists in required_oracle_tiers (e.g. L2 = a functional oracle). A prototype/not-RTL-certified target sets this optional so an unavailable/slow RTL sim never forces incomplete.

semantic.description: Target-conditioned semantic-coverage annotations (Acceleratable Region Recall). semantic_family is the canonical computation family this capsule exercises (derived from operation.op when omitted); eligible is an author override of the independent eligibility oracle (auto = derive); must_accelerate makes a fallback on an eligible region a FAIL; generalization_axis records which held-out axis this capsule probes.

gate.description: Scheduling gate: a whole-model capsule is only run once the op-level suite has proven itself. `after_op_pass_fraction` is the minimum fraction of graded op capsules that must PASS before this capsule is scheduled.
